_comment: Board registry. serial_hint is only a prior: ports are bound to boards by probing (see probe.assign_roles). Evidence for the hints: the stock printer.cfg puts steppers, bed and chamber on [mcu U_1] (/dev/ttyS0) and the extruder on [mcu] (/dev/ttyS2); FreeDi flashes the mainboard on ttyS0 and the toolhead on ttyS2. Both boards are STM32F401-class (mainline board_defs 'qidi-plus4' = stm32f401xc).

toolhead.label: Toolhead board (extruder, hotend, probe)
toolhead.recovery: Re-flash the saved application image through Katapult (eitri-mcuflash rollback toolhead). If Katapult itself is gone the board is only recoverable with a soldered SWD header and an ST-Link V2.

mainboard.label: Mainboard (X/Y/Z steppers, bed, chamber)
mainboard.recovery: Copy the stock qd_mcu.bin to the root of a FAT32 microSD card, insert it in the mainboard slot (case must be opened) and press the mainboard RESET button; the board's SD bootloader flashes it on its own.
